title: Thunder X D7 Red

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Studds Thunder X D7 Red is tailored for spirited twisties and aggressive canyon carving. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1435g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

introduction: Positioned in Studds's Full Face lineup, the Thunder X D7 Red brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Studds Thunder X D7 Red represents Studds's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Studds Thunder X D7 Red delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
